Bank Account Interest Calculator

Problem Statement:
Write a program to calculate simple interest using a constant object of a class.

Description:
Create a class BankAccount with private data member principal.
Use a const member function to calculate simple interest without modifying the object state.
Create the object as constant in main() and compute interest.

Formula:
Interest = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100

Input Format:
Three space-separated numbers:
Principal Rate Time

Output Format:
A single number representing the interest amount.
